findings.title: Patience as social self-binding
findings.claim: The command to be patient makes patience an active binding of the self to the worshipping company: remaining with those who call on their Lord protects attention from being governed by visible status.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier ٱصْبِرْ holds the self in a steady posture, while the adjacent معَ relation locates that restraint with the callers. The near-parallel and company connections at 6:52 and 9:119 independently repeat devoted company as the setting of allegiance, so proximity becomes part of what the patience does.
findings.reader_payoff: Patience becomes observable as chosen company and disciplined attention, rather than a private capacity to endure discomfort.
findings.containment: The primary command to remain patient with the callers remains intact. This finding does not reduce the companions to a social-status lesson, and the retrospective Moses gesture is not activated because it lacks an exact supplied context carrier.

epistemic.reason: A trusted branch-specific finding is anchored at 18:28:1 and is independently reinforced by supplied cross-ayah connection records.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi, sarsıntı ve yakınma dürtüsüne karşı kendini tutar.
branch_activations.carrier: The imperative iṣbir carries self-restraint, and the nearby maʿa phrase places that restraint with the callers.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 6:52 parallel and 9:119 company relation repeat morning-evening devotion and principled belonging as the wider setting of steadfastness.
branch_activations.activation: The wider repetitions meet the focus's patience-plus-company construction, changing patience from an inward endurance label into a social practice that holds attention in the right company.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The addressed self is being kept with the devotional group as part of the act of patience; their low visible status is therefore not a reason to redirect the gaze.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual resonance of active self-restraint and company, not a claim that every use of patience is social or that status is the only pressure in the ayah.

findings.title: Desire as a path with direction
findings.claim: The warning against following desire becomes a contrast between directed following and a self-involving path whose object pulls the follower beyond a bounded end; the related desire word also permits a qualified downward-pressure resonance.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb اتَّبَعَ carries following as moving after or adopting a direction, while the supplied 18:92 relation contrasts desire with the disciplined following of a means and 28:50 names desire without guidance. The focus carrier هَوَىٰ then meets 20:16 and 45:23, where desire is joined to ruin, false allegiance, a sealed heart, and lost remembrance; that wider contact supplies the bounded downward pressure without replacing the ordinary meaning of desire.
findings.reader_payoff: The final portrait shows desire as an organizing route: what is followed determines whether movement remains directed or spills toward ruin.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that the person follows his desire. The downward image is qualified lexical pressure, not a claim that the noun literally asserts a fall, a particular punishment, or that all following is corrupt.

epistemic.reason: The core directed-following claim is trusted and anchored; the additional downward facet is a bounded connection-backed resonance from an accepted but qualified branch.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiyle birlikte ya da onun arkasında ilerleyerek ardından gitmek.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form VIII verb ittabaʿa makes desire the object that is followed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied same-surah relation at 18:92 contrasts following desire with following a supplied means through a journey.
branch_activations.activation: The contrast makes the focus's following verb contact a directed-movement image: the problem is not movement itself but the object that organizes it.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Desire is shown as a path the person has taken up and follows, while a supplied means represents bounded direction.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation distinguishes kinds of following; it does not condemn the branch's ordinary physical or guidance-following uses.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir iz, örnek, buyruk veya öğreti doğrultusunda davranmak ve ona uymak.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus presents desire as the adopted guide of the person described.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 28:50 connection explicitly sets following desire against following guidance.
branch_activations.activation: The wider contrast activates the behavioral extension of following, so the person's desire is read as an adopted directive rather than a passing feeling only.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Following desire is a form of letting an inclination become the rule by which one acts.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not say that every desire is a formal command or that the guidance contrast exhausts the verb's meaning.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yukarıdan düşme; yönlü gidiş, derin çukur, düşürme, ölüm ve yas bağlantıları
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin veya kuşun yukarıdan aşağı düşmesi ve aşağı yönlü ilerlemesi.
branch_activations.carrier: The noun hawā remains desire in the focus while its accepted root branch carries a qualified downward-inclination pressure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 20:16 and 45:23 connections join desire to ruin, false worship, sealed inward response, and loss of remembrance.
branch_activations.activation: Those wider consequences return through the focus's desire object and make the following relation feel directionally downward without erasing the primary sense.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The path organized by desire can overshoot its bounds and descend into loss of orientation.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is qualified and analogical here; the focus is not being translated as a literal fall or as a named punishment.

findings.title: Excess and neglect as one timing disorder
findings.claim: The final judgment on the person's affair can hold excess and neglect together: attention overshoots toward displayed life while remembrance is left underprovided, making both sides of a disordered timing pattern visible.
findings.mechanism: The predicate فُرُطًا carries the accepted excess branch at the focus carrier 18:28:30, while its neighboring accepted branch carries leaving a duty incomplete until it is lost. The supplied connections at 16:62, 6:31, and 19:59 independently join excess, neglected duty, prayer-loss, and desire-following, so the final affair is read as a coupled disorder rather than as an undifferentiated moral extreme.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing phrase becomes a diagnosis of attention's timing: what is overfed and what is abandoned belong to the same pattern.
findings.containment: Both furuṭ facets remain live. The finding does not decide whether excess and neglect are successive phases or simultaneous aspects, and it does not replace the plain judgment that the affair has exceeded proper measure.

epistemic.reason: The trusted finding supplies both exact focus branches, and the connection records separately ground their excess and neglect contacts.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir işte buyurulanı, uygun ölçüyü veya belirlenmiş sınırı fazlalık yönünde aşmak.
branch_activations.carrier: The final predicate furuṭā judges the man's whole affair as exceeding a proper measure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 16:62 connection repeats excess as a consequence-bearing pattern rather than a neutral quantity.
branch_activations.activation: The wider excess relation returns through the predicate and makes its measure language explanatory of the person's whole course.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The affair has overflowed the bounds that should have governed it.
branch_activations.boundary: This facet is the excess direction only; it does not by itself assert neglect or material waste.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir işi gerektiği gibi yapmayıp eksik bırakarak elden kaçmasına yol açmak.
branch_activations.carrier: The same final predicate can describe an affair left underprovided until its proper work is lost.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 6:31 and 19:59 connections join neglected duty and neglected prayer to the desire-following sequence.
branch_activations.activation: Those omissions return through the focus's heedless heart and final affair, making loss by neglect a live companion to excess.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Remembrance is not merely absent; the person's affair has also been left without the care needed to preserve it.
branch_activations.boundary: This facet is the underprovision and loss direction; it does not cancel the independently retained excess facet.

findings.title: Two directions of attention
findings.claim: The focus places the callers' wanting of His face beside the addressed person's wanting of worldly adornment; wider uses let the first carry an aimed devotional purpose and the second gather displayed goods and status, so the redirection of the eyes becomes a contest between what is made an end and what is made socially attractive.
findings.mechanism: The focus repeats the wanting relation with two objects, وَجْهَهُ and زِينَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا. The supplied face connections at 13:22 and 28:88 ground face as goal and devotional orientation; 28:79 and 28:83 return through status and visible adornment, while 7:32 preserves a qualification about permitted adornment. The accepted adornment branch then supplies the class of external qualities and things that make a person or thing appear embellished.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse's contrast becomes concrete: attention is being trained toward a divine end while the competing gaze is drawn by a public surface of wealth, prestige, and display.
findings.containment: This is a bounded contextual synthesis, not an equation of the divine face with human status and not a condemnation of every form of beauty or adornment. The primary objects and prohibitions remain recoverable, and the status contrast is an inference from the supplied connections.

epistemic.reason: Exact focus carriers, accepted branch facets, and multiple supplied connection records ground the relation, while the combined contrast is an authoring inference and the connection registry supplies no independent trust labels.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: amaç edinip yönelme; ibadette içtenlikle bağlanma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir hedefi amaç edinip ona yönelmeyi belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The sought wajh is the object toward which the callers' wanting is directed.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 13:22 and 28:88 connections repeat seeking or turning the face toward God as a goal and devotional orientation.
branch_activations.activation: The wider goal-oriented uses meet the focus's wanting verb and make the sought face function as an end that organizes the callers' attention.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The company's devotion is oriented toward a chosen divine end, not merely toward a general religious feeling.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is used for goal and devotional orientation; no literal anatomy or single theological gloss is imposed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: toplumsal itibar, yüksek mevki ve önde gelen kişi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin başkaları yanındaki toplumsal mevki, değer ve saygınlığını belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: The same face word stands in the focus as the divine object whose pursuit is set against worldly display.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 28:79 and 28:83 connections explicitly return through visible fortune, worldly adornment, exaltation, and social status.
branch_activations.activation: The status branch makes the contrast legible as competing valuations: a divine end is placed beside the public prestige that worldly adornment can display.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The command protects the company from being measured by the social face that worldly display gives to a person.
branch_activations.boundary: Status is a contextual pressure in the contrast, not the focus word's sole meaning and not a claim that the companions are defined only by social rank.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bezenmeye yarayan nitelik ve şeylerin bütünü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kavram, bezenmek için kullanılan veya kişiyi ya da şeyi bezeyen her türlü nitelik ve unsurun ortak adıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus names worldly zīna as the object that attracts the addressed person's wanting.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 28:79 and 102:1 connections show worldly fortune, visible adornment, and rivalry in accumulation as public attractions.
branch_activations.activation: Those wider displays return through zīna and expand the object from an abstract beauty into the class of things and qualities by which people appear worth looking at.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The forbidden gaze is drawn toward a socially displayed surface rather than toward beauty in isolation.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch concerns the class of embellishing things and qualities; it does not make all adornment blameworthy.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bezenmeye yarayan nitelik ve şeylerin bütünü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dünyalık tür, malı, eşyayı ve toplumsal saygınlığı kişiyi bezeyen dışsal unsurlar olarak bir araya getirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The worldly qualifier keeps zīna attached to the displayed life and its external goods.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Qarun's visible fortune and rivalry in accumulation supply the worldly specialization of adornment.
branch_activations.activation: The specialized external-display facet gives the eye's prohibited movement a concrete social object: possessions and prestige made visible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Worldly adornment can include the goods and public standing through which a person is made to appear elevated.
branch_activations.boundary: This specialization survives with its core facet, but it remains one activated worldly facet rather than an exhaustive definition of zīna.

findings.title: Remembrance as an active tether
findings.claim: The remembrance from which the heart is made heedless is rendered as an active God-oriented practice that orders attention across the day, so heedlessness becomes separation from a practiced tether rather than a neutral lack of information.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier ذِكْرِنَا can carry the accepted worship-remembrance branch. The supplied connections at 20:14, 24:37, 7:205, and 43:36 return through prayer, repeated remembrance, protection from distraction, and the consequence of turning away; they give the remembrance domain an active rhythm that explains what the heart loses.
findings.reader_payoff: The warning about the heart becomes operational: desire does not merely coexist with forgetfulness, it occupies the attention that a recurring practice was meant to keep oriented.
findings.containment: The ordinary sense of remembering God remains intact, and the finding does not decide between personal recollection and divine reminder as every possible sense of dhikr. It makes only the supplied worship-oriented facet global here.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier, accepted branch facet, and multiple direct connection records are exact, while the active-tether synthesis is an authoring inference from connection evidence without a separate support trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Tanrı'ya yönelmiş bir kulluk ve bilinçli anma eylemidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The genitive dhikr of the focus names the remembrance-domain from which the heart has been made heedless.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 20:14, 24:37, 7:205, and 43:36 connections represent remembrance as prayer, repeated practice, resistance to distraction, and a domain from which turning away has consequences.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated practice returns through the focus's remembrance object and changes heedlessness from a static mental gap into loss of an active orientation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The desire-led person has become separated from the practice that repeatedly reorients the heart toward God.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is the worship-oriented remembrance facet only; no exclusive claim about scripture, memory, or divine causation is added.
